formulas.other_opex: sga + separation_costs + rd + interest_and_other_financial_charges + insurance_losses_and_other_costs + goodwill_impairments

equipment_revenue_yoy.description: Equipment revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

services_revenue_yoy.description: Services revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

insurance_revenue_yoy.description: Insurance revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

cogs_margin_delta_bps.description: Combined COGS as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

sga_margin_delta_bps.description: SG&A as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

separation_costs_yoy.description: Separation costs YoY growth rate vs Q-4

rd_yoy.description: R&D expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

interest_charges_yoy.description: Interest and other financial charges YoY growth rate vs Q-4

insurance_losses_yoy.description: Insurance losses, annuity benefits and other costs YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_income_yoy.description: Other income (loss) YoY growth rate vs Q-4

goodwill_impairments_abs.description: goodwill_impairments absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

non_operating_benefit_income_abs.description: non_operating_benefit_income absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

nci_abs.description: nci absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

preferred_dividends_abs.description: preferred_dividends absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.
